hooks.command: input=$(cat); iso=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.isolation // empty"); if [ "$iso" = "worktree" ]; then root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/teleclaude.yml" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Worktree isolation for the Agent tool is prohibited in TeleClaude-managed repos (teleclaude.yml at repo root). Parallel subagents must work on disjoint files within the current worktree, not spawn additional git worktrees.\"}}"; else echo "{}"; fi; else echo "{}"; fi
